Nivel de vechime: Nu se aplică
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
About The Role
 In this role, you will work as a Lead Full-stack Software Engineer on large-scale corporate information systems within a European public-sector environment, supporting grants, experts, and procurement management.
You will lead the technical development and modernization of the eExperts platform, contributing to new features, enhancements of existing functionality, architectural improvements, and production support.
Working in an international, multicultural environment, you will combine hands-on full-stack development with technical leadership, ensuring high standards of software design, code quality, security, and delivery. You will guide cross-functional development teams, ensuring alignment with established application architecture and scaled Agile and PM2-Agile frameworks.
 Responsibilities
Lead technical development activities, ensuring adherence to software design, coding, quality, and delivery standards.
Ensure technical solutions align with established application architecture and scaled Agile and PM2-Agile frameworks.
Design, develop, and maintain frontend and backend application components, including responsive user interfaces, business logic, APIs, and database interactions.
Build secure, scalable applications using Java, Node.js, PHP, Spring Boot, Hibernate, and modern frontend technologies.
Design, implement, secure, and document RESTful APIs and web services.
Apply security best practices for input validation, authentication, authorization, secure storage, logging, and monitoring.
Optimize application performance, usability, and compatibility across browsers and devices.
Develop and maintain integrations between frontend, backend, databases, and external systems.
Perform unit and integration testing, debugging, and production troubleshooting.
Deploy and maintain applications using AWS, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and Kubernetes.
Ensure code quality, maintainability, and compliance with technical and architectural standards.
Analyze code, data, and processes to identify technical issues, risks, and improvement opportunities.
Maintain technical documentation and support continuous improvement of existing applications.
Coordinate technical activities across cross-functional teams, ensuring cohesive integration of all system components.
Apply AI-assisted development tools to improve code quality and productivity while ensuring proper review of AI-generated code.
 Requirements
University degree corresponding to EQF Level 6 (Bachelor's degree or equivalent) and at least 17 years of professional IT experience.
Strong hands-on experience in full-stack software development, combined with technical leadership responsibilities.
Advanced Java backend development expertise, including Java 19/21/25, Spring Framework, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Hibernate, and REST API development.
Strong proficiency in Node.js and PHP backend development.
Knowledge of Spring Boot Actuator and Spring Boot Test.
Advanced knowledge of Java EE/Jakarta EE technologies, including EJB 3, CDI, JMS, and WebLogic 14.
Experience with Maven, Hibernate JPA, and Liquibase.
Strong proficiency in JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
Advanced knowledge of frontend frameworks and libraries, including Angular, Vue, and Bootstrap.
Advanced knowledge of frontend build tools and libraries such as Webpack, Vite, Nx, and RxJS.
Strong experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, Oracle) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB), including schema design and query optimization.
Good knowledge of Elasticsearch and object-relational mapping technologies.
Advanced experience designing, developing, and securing RESTful APIs and web services, including OpenAPI/Swagger documentation.
Very good understanding of authentication and authorization standards, including OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and JWT.
Very good knowledge of Apache Kafka and experience with integration technologies such as JAX-WS, JAXB, and Protobuf.
Good knowledge of workflow engines such as Camunda and Activiti, including BPMN 2.
Strong experience with AWS cloud services and deploying and managing applications in cloud environments.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools, including Terraform and AWS CloudFormation.
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and Container as a Service (CaaS).
Knowledge of Consul for service discovery and configuration, and AWS Virtual Desktop Infrastructure.
Advanced experience with Git workflows, including GitFlow and trunk-based development, and strong knowledge of GitLab and Bitbucket, with an understanding of SVN.
Experience with architectural patterns, including hexagonal architecture, microservices, and CQRS.
Knowledge of monitoring and observability tools, including Kibana, Dynatrace, Prometheus, Micrometer, and distributed tracing.
Very good knowledge of JUnit 4/5 and familiarity with Mockito, Vitest, and Playwright.
Extensive experience with large-scale Agile development practices and Jira for backlog and task management.
Good knowledge of AI-assisted development tools such as Amazon Q and Kiro, including reviewing and maintaining AI-generated code.
Advanced ability to integrate frontend and backend builds into CI/CD pipelines.
Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
Strong ability to apply software development, security, cloud, and quality best practices.
Proven ability to lead technical teams, ensure coding standards, and maintain high-quality delivery.
Ability to assess technical risks, review the quality of others' work, and proactively address potential issues.
Strong communication skills, including presenting technical findings, documenting solutions, and aligning multidisciplinary teams.
Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams.
Ability to adapt quickly to new technologies, assignments, and changing priorities while maintaining delivery quality.
Proactive, results-oriented approach with strong prioritization skills and a commitment to continuous improvement.
English or French proficiency at B2 level or higher, both spoken and written.
 Nice to Have
Experience developing or maintaining public-sector information systems.
Knowledge of grant management, expert management, or procurement-related platforms.
Oracle Certified Professional: Java SE 21 Developer, Jakarta EE Application Developer, or Spring Professional Certification.
AWS Certified Developer – Associate or equivalent certification.
 SoftServe is an equal opportunity employer.
